ticket.title: Return 429 with Retry-After when the rate limiter trips
ticket.body:
---
key: GAT-1
title: Return 429 with Retry-After when the rate limiter trips
status: ready
priority: P1
---

## Context

The limiter currently drops over-quota requests with a bare 503 and no hint of when to retry, so
clients back off blindly and retry storms build up behind it.

## Acceptance criteria

- Over-quota requests get `429 Too Many Requests`
- The response carries `Retry-After` in seconds, matching the window the limiter is actually using
- Under-quota traffic is unaffected
